svg.title: Before and after one round of fixes, measured on the same television
svg.desc: Five measurements in milliseconds on a logarithmic scale, each shown before and after. Changing the painting, the time the page was frozen reading the picture: 943 to 1,318 ms before, 18 to 25 ms after. Dock sliding at night, slowest single frame: 282 ms before, 37 to 41 ms after. Dock sliding by day, typical frame: 85 ms before, 25 ms after. App drawer opening, typical frame: 57 ms before, 23 ms after. Opening Netflix from the dock, from the press to the hand-over with the app already loaded: 389 ms before, 231 ms after. One Xiaomi television, Android 11, 1,788 MB of RAM, measured on 4 November 2026 with the panel dark.
svg.text: Before and after one round of fixes, on the same television
Milliseconds on a logarithmic scale: each line is about three times the one before it.
